title: This is HUGE! Will be No1 in time
body:
NO APP on the App Store does what TF does so beautifully. Drag and drop well-organised tasks onto a well-organised calendar in a simple, beautiful, clear way AND THEN SHIFT THEM ALL WHEN YOU FAIL TO COMPLETE TODAY’S TASKS (just by asking the built in AI helper). 

Things 3 can SHIFT but it can’t drag onto Calendar. Ticktick and Todoist can’t SHIFT but can drag to calendar in a busy and convoluted way (and they’re all expensive!). 

TF is the simple, low-cost, beautiful solution for everyone.
author: Tige2021

title: Excellent App
body: I have been searching for a timetable style app for a long time, attempting to adapt school timetable apps to what I need. I’m not sure how I finally found this one, but it is exactly what I needed. I am managing a chronic health condition and am using this app to organise my routine using traffic light colours to quickly track where I need to manage my energy better. It is really nice to look at and easy to use; so much better than the clunky alternatives out there. Thank you for creating an app I can finally use long term!

title: Nagging,persistent pro upgrade reminders ruin otherwise promising app
body: I like the look of TimeFinder. It appears to be a well thought out and cleverly designed app. I trialled the pro option a while ago but didn’t want to commit to the one time purchase at the time, so opted to keep the free version and double check that the app fitted into my workflow. But I am now at the end of my patience with one huge flaw in TimeFinder. Constant, repetitive reminders to upgrade to Pro with no way to dismiss the nags. No cross to close the screen. No option to say no thank you. I even tried to submit feedback within the app and the dreaded Pro upgrade screen stopped me from writing the email to the developer. I want to like TimeFinder. But for anyone wanting to try it out in free mode it is literally useless with this problem blocking every attempt to do so. Such a shame. Please fix.

title: Please fix the “Today” button
body:

This is one of the features I rely on the most, and now I have to scroll manually every time, which is very inconvenient.

I hope the developers can fix this as soon as possible. Thank you!
author: Betty zi

title: Love it
body:
I have ADHD and getting organised and stopping procrastination was something that I had tried many times over several years to overcome, but no joy. My desk has 2 or 3 post its with my to do list. I also use a book for extra things to do. I had used other apps for help with planning etc, but I never really enjoyed using them so I never really stuck with them. The thing I like about TimeFinder is the option of having whatever colour scheme you like and ease of use. Im using the free version but want to purchase it to use on my iMac and MacBook, and although I can see an option to purchase on my phone, I do not have an option to purchase the lifetime version on my iMac or MacBook, so if anyone knows, please let me know. I would be grateful.

Edit on 07/11. I have increased my rating to a 5 star as the Luke the Developer has kindly confirmed about purchasing this as a lifetime license.
I have just purchased the lifetime license and am excited!
I also love how you can customise with different colour palettes and not only that, but you can actually add additional colours to each palette. Dream come true for me as Im very particular about colours and the feel of apps that I use. Thanks again Luke.

One final thing, I have increased my review to 5 stars but when I look at the reviews, my reviews till has 4 stars against it. Is this because it takes time to update?

To features for the future:
Ticking off tasks - would be more intuitive to have a box on each one instead of dragging the left hand side and clicking (how they do it in reminders) Also I keep accidentally ticking a task off in the schedule when amending, thinking the tick is to save the amendment

Duration countdown - on the current task if there was clock/numbers in the box on schedule that would be helpful - as someone who struggles with calculating time that would help with a quick glance how much time I have left on said task

author: afteredward

title: Excellent
body:
Have tried a lot of day planners / time blockers but this beats them all So easy to use and versatile, I would definitely recommend this app , keep up the good work. Update 7th July I initially used the GTD method for handling my todo lists and Daily Planning, but have since drifted over to the Time Blocking Method which I find suits the way my mind works a lot better. This App is in my opinion way ahead of a lot of others available. The features that stand out for me are : (1) Having the split screen function (especially on the iPhone) showing whichever ToDo list you want on one side, and the ToDo Schedule on the other side and be able to slide a ToDo into a Time Slot (This feature is Fantastic) (2) In the Schedule view you can import Appointments from your Calendar a day at a time which can be done the night before when you are planning the next day. (3) When in Schedule view you can easily move or extend the task time as Priorities change during the day. I have only mentioned one or two of the features which make it a must have App for myself. I would definitely recommend trying this App if you are into Time Blocking. Another plus is the Developer is very active , listens to comments and is bringing new updates
Updated 11th Jan 2022
The latest update has added a number of additional features which raise this app to a new level. A couple of them are : You can import all the appointments from your diary with it working seamlessly in the background : A new Week view has been introduced which gives the opportunity to plan ahead . Well done to the developer who listens to what the users say.

Another great feature is the abilty to change the the time periods on the planner.  I always work to 15 minute time blocks every day so I chose that, but you can do choose from 5/10/15/30/60 blocks. 
I had an issue initally and the developer responded very quickly and a new version has justsolved everything. 
There are other features that I'd like to see in future updates, including task sub folders, the abilty to mark tasks as done once completed.  I think that this is an App which will just get better as it goes on though.
